rule_set_name: Lesen Premis Perniagaan & Iklan — Majlis Bandaraya Johor Bahru
primary_source: Undang-Undang Kecil Pelesenan Iklan (Majlis Bandaraya Johor Bahru) 2010
secondary_sources: Notis Peringatan / Garis Panduan Papan Iklan Premis, MBJB (published 2025-07)
Borang Permohonan Lesen Premis Perniagaan dan Iklan, MBJB
_IMPORTANT: Every rule carries verification_status. Anything not 'verified_against_bylaw_text' must be confirmed with MBJB Bahagian Pelesenan before this is shown to MBJB as authoritative. Do not silently promote a rule to verified.

autonomy_tiers.auto: Objective and measurable from extracted observations. Engine decides; officer may override.
autonomy_tiers.recommend: Engine produces a finding; case cannot advance until an officer acknowledges it.
autonomy_tiers.escalate: Engine declines to determine. Officer decides, with retrieved context supplied.

document_checklist.label: Latest paid property tax (cukai harta) receipt for the current year
Identity document — MyKad for citizens, passport for non-citizens
Signboard artwork or visual, showing all text and dimensions
document_checklist.notes: Required by this system as the input to signboard analysis. Confirm MBJB's own submission requirement.

document_checklist.label: Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka (DBP) verification or approval of signboard content and visual
document_checklist.notes: MBJB guideline states all signage content/visuals require DBP approval. Treated as an applicant-supplied document in this POC; no DBP API integration.

document_checklist.label: Proof of premise occupation — tenancy agreement or ownership document
Premise floor plan or layout showing floor area

rules.title: National language must appear on the signboard
rules.citation: UUK Pelesenan Iklan (MBJB) 2010 — bahasa kebangsaan hendaklah digunapakai bagi semua jenis iklan, sama ada secara sendiri atau bersama-sama dengan apa-apa bahasa lain
rules.corrective_action_template: Add Bahasa Melayu text to the signboard. The national language is mandatory on all advertisements, whether alone or alongside another language.

rules.title: The displayed business name or brand must be the largest text on the board
rules.citation: UUK Pelesenan Iklan (MBJB) 2010 — a business may choose whether the business name or the sales brand is displayed, and the size of that wording must be larger than the other wording on the signboard
rules.corrective_action_template: Increase the {primary_run} text so it is larger than every other text element on the signboard. Currently {largest_run} is larger.

rules.title: Non-national-language script must not exceed three-quarters of the business name lettering
rules.basis: glyph height of the registered business name text run
rules.citation: UUK Pelesenan Iklan (MBJB) 2010 — for a business registered in another language such as Chinese or Tamil, the lettering size of the advertisement must not exceed three-quarters (3/4) of the lettering size of the business name
rules.corrective_action_template: Reduce the {script} lettering to no more than 75% of the business name lettering height. Measured ratio is {measured_ratio}, which exceeds the 0.75 limit.
rules.notes: FLAGSHIP DEMO RULE. Measurable directly from glyph heights. Unit-test both sides of the boundary: 0.74 pass, 0.75 pass (inclusive), 0.76 fail. Confirm inclusivity with MBJB.

rules.title: Registered business name must be retained as written in the other language
rules.citation: UUK Pelesenan Iklan (MBJB) 2010 — the business name as registered and written in other languages must be retained
rules.escalation_reason: Requires comparing signboard text against the SSM registration document; transliteration judgement is not safely automatable.

rules.title: Bahasa Melayu wording, spelling and grammar must be correct
rules.citation: UUK Pelesenan Iklan (MBJB) 2010 — the wording, sentence structure, spelling, grammar and vocabulary of the national language on a business signboard must be correct and accurate, and approved by the Datuk Bandar or an authorised officer
rules.corrective_action_template: Amend the signboard to correct the Bahasa Melayu errors identified, within the period stated in the Council's written notice.
rules.notes: The Copilot may SUGGEST suspected errors as advisory context, clearly labelled as unverified. The determination is the officer's, and DBP verification is the formal channel.

rules.title: Trademark, logo, label or slogan requires Datuk Bandar approval
rules.citation: UUK Pelesenan Iklan (MBJB) 2010 — a trademark, logo, label or slogan on a business signboard must be used with the approval of the Datuk Bandar or an authorised officer
rules.escalation_reason: Approval is a discretionary act reserved to the Datuk Bandar or an authorised officer.

rules.title: DBP verification of signboard content and visual must be evidenced
rules.citation: MBJB Garis Panduan Papan Iklan Premis — all signboard content and visuals require Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka approval
rules.corrective_action_template: Obtain and upload DBP verification of the signboard content and visual before the application can proceed.

rules.title: Premise signboard dimensions must not exceed the permitted size
rules.citation: MBJB Borang Permohonan Lesen Premis Perniagaan dan Iklan — counter checklist states only 20 ft x 4 ft is permitted
rules.corrective_action_template: Reduce the signboard to within {threshold_imperial}. Submitted size is {measured}.
rules.notes: Sourced from the form's checklist page rather than the by-law text itself, and may be a default rather than an absolute cap, and may vary by premise type or storey count. Tier is 'recommend' not 'auto' for that reason. MUST be confirmed with MBJB Bahagian Pelesenan.

rules.title: Business activity must be shown on the signboard in the national language
rules.citation: MBJB Borang Permohonan Lesen Premis Perniagaan dan Iklan — the business activity must be in the national language
rules.corrective_action_template: State the business activity on the signboard in Bahasa Melayu.

rules.title: All mandatory supporting documents must be present and legible
rules.citation: MBJB Borang Permohonan Lesen Premis Perniagaan dan Iklan — supporting documents checklist

rules.title: Applicant and premise details must be consistent across documents
fields: premise_address: form vs property tax receipt
property_tax_account_no: form vs property tax receipt
rules.corrective_action_template: Resolve the mismatch in {field}: the form states {form_value}, the supporting document states {doc_value}.
rules.notes: Mismatches are frequently legitimate (trading name vs registered name, unit numbering conventions). Never auto-reject on this; always route to an officer.

rules.title: High-risk business activity requires referral and additional guideline compliance
rules.citation: MBJB Garis Panduan Perniagaan Berisiko Tinggi — health service and entertainment activity categories
rules.escalation_reason: High-risk categories require referral to external agencies and compliance with a separate MBJB guideline outside this rule pack.
rules.notes: MBJB also publishes a separate guideline for budget hotels in terrace-shop premises. Out of scope for the POC; escalate rather than attempt.

confidence_thresholds._note: Below threshold, emit an escalation instead of a finding. These are starting values and must be tuned against real submissions, not left at their defaults.

demo_case._purpose: The scripted live demonstration. Deliberately mixes clean passes, a measurable fail, and an escalation, so the audience sees the system decline as well as succeed.

expected_findings.note: 258mm / 300mm = 0.86, exceeds the 0.75 limit. This is the finding the demo turns on.
DBP verification not uploaded on first submission.
